description: After its own transmission a node with more data waits lbt_wait_vdcd_ms, then NODE_SLOT_POSITION slots rather than one fewer.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). Each S_UNIDATA_REQUEST is to SAP 5, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0 (the 648000-unit default, so TTD = request time + 1296000000 ms, A-0089, A-0091), and asks for no confirmation, so it produces no SIS output (A-0095). The CAS wraps the DATA S_PDU (priority, SAP 5 to SAP 5, TTD) in a DATA C_PDU (B-0297). Each D_PDU is type 7 NON-ARQ-DATA (C-0323, C-0575) with EOW 0, EMPTY (C-0398), address size 4, source 0.0.1.2, the whole C_PDU as its one segment (offset 0, C_PDU size = segment size, C-0343, C-0346), DELIVER IN ORDER clear (C-0333), C_PDU IDs allocated from 0 in placement order (C-0326, C-1040), and no pre-fill (D-0003). The air start of a D_PDU is the start of the block holding its first byte, preamble_ms + block x block_ms (C-1043); EOT = ceil((duration_ms - air start) / 500) (C-0104, C-0891, D-0005, D-0017), and the reception window is the same value because every copy of the C_PDU is in this transmission (C-0350, C-0352). The waveform is drc.default_speed, wn 2 long (C-0894). Position 1: the first round waits (1 - 1) x 3000 = 0 ms and transmits at the LBT expiry. The second request arrives while the node is in LINKING, so it waits for the next transmission (one visit to LINKING is one transmission, K-0095). At 35550 the transmission ends: SENSE, and with data queued and the channel idle, LBT_WAIT at once. Our own end counts as VDCD-determined, so 3000 ms (K-0074), and the last transmission was ours, so 1 x 3000 ms of contention (K-0082, K-0086). The second C_PDU takes ID 1. Each transmission is one block, duration 5550 ms.
